_comment: Tier D exact-count gate for CI (docs/libsm64.md, Continuous integration): the deterministic tilt-target stage of tierd-deterministic.json cut to 100 shots on 4 threads so a hosted runner finishes it in minutes, cost model off so every count is exact. Its expected counts are perf/baselines/tierd-ci.json; regenerate them with the same command whenever the framework legitimately changes its work. Paths resolve against this file; tierd-ci-linux.json is the same with the .so pattern.
